title: Whodunnit in the Enigmatic Study
story: In the opulent mansion of eccentric billionaire, Mr. Wilberforce, a dark and stormy night. As the storm raged outside, a deafening thud echoed through the mansion, followed by the muffled cries of Mr. Wilberforce, who had been found slumped over in his study with a bullet wound to the chest.
victim: The wealthy and reclusive Mr. Wilberforce
crimeScene: The study was locked from the inside with no signs of forced entry. A handwritten note on the desk read: 'I'm afraid you won't find me guilty, Mr. Detective.'
forensicClue: The murder weapon was a .32 caliber revolver with Mr. Wilberforce's fingerprints on it.
question: Who pulled the trigger and how did they gain entry? Please select one suspect.
options: Option A: Miss Lydia (Maid and reason)
Option B: Mr. Charles (Head Gardener and reason)
Option C: Mrs. Regina (Rooms Manager and reason)
Option D: Mr. Theodore (Private Investigator and reason)
